title: Canyons Endurance Runs by UTMB — main page (2026 edition)
publisher: UTMB World Series / Canyons Endurance Runs by UTMB
claims: The main page at access is the 2026 edition (23–26 April 2026) and lists the 100M as 100 miles/18,208 ft+, the 100K as 62.1 miles/12,303 ft+, the 50K as 31 miles/5,577 ft+ and the 25K as 15.5 miles/2,788 ft+.
The page says the 2026 Canyons 100K is a Western States Endurance Run Super Golden Ticket race in which the top three female and male finishers earn direct entry to the 2026 Western States.
The page says the event is a qualifier for the UTMB World Series Finals and the Western States Endurance Run.
The page says runners cover up to 17,000 ft on the Western States Trail, passing Rucky Chucky, Devil's Thumb and Swinging Bridge.
